# Ai-Team — .NET Agent Toolkit for BootStrap

**New here? Run `/at-status` first** — it scans your project and recommends exactly which commands to use next.

## Agents

| Agent | Description | Activation |
|-------|-------------|------------|
| `/at-init-setup` | Sets up or refreshes project context (CONTEXT.md, OpenSpec config, module glossaries) | "setup context", "refresh context", "at-init-setup" |
| `/at-init-constitute` | Multi-discipline constitution ceremony (BA, Arch, QA, DevOps, Security) | "constitute", "run ceremony", "governance ceremony" |
| `/at-init-bootstrap` | Interviews the developer and scaffolds a new .NET solution | "new project", "bootstrap", "scaffold solution" |
| `/at-plan` | Produces a spec from a user story; drives the plan→apply loop | "plan", "create spec", "write spec for..." |
| `/at-apply` | Applies a confirmed spec to the codebase | "apply", "implement spec", "build it" |
| `/at-validate` | Multi-discipline gate review (BA / Arch / QA / Security) | "validate", "review spec", "check alignment" |
| `/at-status` | Diagnoses project state and recommends next step | "status", "diagnose", "what next" |
| `/at-arch-improve` | Proposes and implements architecture improvements with ADRs | "improve architecture", "add pattern", "arch review" |
| `/at-context-grill` | Deep-grills the developer to enrich CONTEXT.md | "grill context", "enrich context", "at-context-grill" |
| `/at-context-sync` | Syncs CONTEXT.md and OpenSpec config after a session | "sync context", "update context" |
| `/at-meta-improve` | Reviews and improves project-local skills | "improve skill", "review skill" |
| `/at-meta-teach` | Teaches a new pattern to the AI team as a project-local skill | "teach pattern", "add skill", "at-meta-teach" |

## Skills (project-local)

| Skill | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `diagnose-project` | Scans repo signals → maturity level + recommended next step |
| `write-context` | Writes CONTEXT.md, OpenSpec config, CONTEXT-MAP.md, module glossaries |
| `write-architecture` | Writes ARCHITECTURE.md from architecture scan |
| `write-adr` | Writes a single ADR file to `docs/adr/` |
| `read-context` | Reads and returns structured project context (vertical load) |
| `discipline-review` | Multi-lens review: BA / Architecture / QA / Security → verdict |
| `detect-architecture` | Scans .NET repo and returns structured architecture report |
| `sync-context` | Reconciles CONTEXT.md drift after a session |
